summary: Biomea Fusion filed an 8-K furnishing a slide deck and press release under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing topline Phase 1 GLP-131 trial results for BMF-650, an investigational next-generation oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist for obesity and metabolic disease. The October 13, 2026 disclosure accompanied a conference call and webcast; no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a routine clinical-data current report, not a special situation; watch for dose-selection, regulatory interaction timing, and any subsequent financing given the clinical-stage capital need.
